symbols.name: neighbour count
symbols.meaning: The number of triples that are neighbours of a fixed triple, which is 13968 when h = 100.
symbols.quote: For a fixed triple $T$, let $z_b$ be the number of triples meeting $T$ in exactly one element, which are the neighbours of $T$.

relations.quote: The neighbour rule is stated in terms of [indicator vectors](indicator-vector.md): for $S,T\in\mathcal K$, the intersection size is the dot product $|S\cap T| = t_S\cdot t_T$, so the rule is a condition on that dot product.
The bit construction has its scalars in the [Binary field](binary-field.md) $\mathbb{F}_2$, where addition is exclusive or and multiplication is AND, so every scalar is a single bit.

The bit construction is a specialization of the [Subset-intersection network](subset-intersection-network.md) to scalars in $\mathbb F_2$, in which two triples are neighbours when they share exactly one element.
